title: Magnetic induction magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must correctly state B = 0.5 T.

title: Specific charge value
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must correctly state q/m = 10 C/kg.

title: Force balance in third quadrant
description: Important: The solution must apply force equilibrium (gravity, electric, magnetic) for the constant-velocity motion along PO.

title: Geometry of exit point
description: Important: The solution must correctly combine the straight-line segments and the circular arc to find the final x-coordinate (1.6 m).

title: Time breakdown calculation
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the three time intervals (two straight, one quarter-circle) and sum them for the total time (0.714 s).

title: Circular motion in magnetic field
description: Important: The solution must recognize the quarter-circular motion in the first quadrant's upper magnetic field and apply qvB = mv²/r.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly assigns the direction of a force (e.g., Lorentz force, electric force) leading to wrong equilibrium or motion.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution demonstrates consistent use of SI units throughout the calculation.
